ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with HIST 495, Section C. Topic: The Life and Death of Civilians in World War II. Description: This course is designed to allow students to a write a substantial research or historiographical paper. To introduce the subject at hand, we will look at six thematic areas: the battle for food; the patriotic mythology around Britain's "People?s War," "choices" in German-occupied France; the "final solution" against Europe's Jews in Poland; the air war in Germany; and sex and rape at war's end. Diaries, reportages, novels, and films will supplement the secondary sources.
